verdict.rationale: Make documents an in-product AI Agents app for agentic automation, with matching API endpoints in open beta. That could plausibly be used to have AI process scenario data inside the product, but nothing describes AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's data. The analytics endpoint is plain, Enterprise-only data retrieval, not AI. Missing for 10: any documented in-product AI insights or suggestions over user data, any description of what the AI Agents app produces from data, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
